candidate_relations.reason: The INL/OPL hyperreflective plaques and subsequent middle retinal atrophy support paracentral acute middle maculopathy, while no peripheral neovascularization—the defining proliferative feature—was present.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Proliferative sickle cell retinopathy is a different retinopathy subtype from paracentral acute middle maculopathy associated with sickle cell disease.
